name: Abi
title: King Hezekiah's mother
summary: Abi, daughter of Zechariah, was the wife of King Ahaz and the mother of King Hezekiah of Judah. She is also called Abijah in Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Hezekiah
keyEvents.description: Hezekiah's mother was named Abi and was the daughter of Zechariah.
